heroHeadline: Russia Reportedly Hijacks Ukrainian Drones via GPS Spoofing, Diverting Them into Baltic States
heroSubtitle: Multiple NATO member states are expanding European air-defense supply chains by procuring a US-made short-range interceptor system credited with downing thousands of Russian drones over Ukraine, reflecting the alliance's push to bolster territorial air-defense capacity.
